triples.tail_surface: ultrasonic examination of the tube plate to shell connection
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 管板与壳体连接处超声检测
triples.evidence_text: Every shell type exhaust gas economizer is to be provided with removable lagging at the circumference of the tube end plates to enable ultrasonic examination of the tube plate to shell connection.

triples.tail_surface: Feed water treatment and sampling arrangements
triples.evidence_text: The manufacturer is to provide operating instructions for each shell type exhaust gas economizer which is to include reference to: i) Feed water treatment and sampling arrangements.
The manufacturer is to provide operating instructions for each shell type exhaust gas economizer which is to include reference to: iv) Inspection and cleaning procedures.

triples.tail_surface: maintain adequate water flow through the economizer under all operating conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在所有工况下维持通过经济器的足够水流量
triples.evidence_text: The manufacturer is to provide operating instructions for each shell type exhaust gas economizer which is to include reference to: vi) The need to maintain adequate water flow through the economizer under all operating conditions.

The manufacturer is to provide operating instructions for each shell type exhaust gas economizer which is to include reference to: vii) Periodical operational checks of the safety devices to be carried out by the operating personnel and to be documented accordingly.

triples.tail_surface: Procedures for maintenance and overhaul of safety valves
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安全阀维护和检修程序
triples.evidence_text: The manufacturer is to provide operating instructions for each shell type exhaust gas economizer which is to include reference to: ix) Procedures for maintenance and overhaul of safety valves.
